findings.claim: 單一客戶（多專案，跨 Civil/Building/Specialty）占合併營收 2025 年 14.1%、2024 年 17.6%、2023 年 16.3%；2025 年另有第二大客戶占 11.4%，兩者合計約 25.5%。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Major Customers 附註
findings.excerpt: Revenue from a single customer with multiple projects impacting the Civil, Building and Specialty Contractors segments represented 14.1%, 17.6% and 16.3% of the Company’s consolidated revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively. Revenue from an additional customer with multiple projects, impacting the Civil, Building and Specialty Contractors segments, represented 11.4% of the Company’s consolidated revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025.

note: 搜尋未找到 2026 年客戶破產、信用評等調降或財測下修的來源；客戶名稱未在摘錄中揭露。評等機構最新評等未查到。
